text: When you feel something dark surrounding you, that envy reaches you, or that an unexplained sadness won't let you go, there exists a declaration so ancient that it breaks all darkness. Today I want to share it with you. Put your hand on your chest, close your eyes, and repeat in silence. I close every door through which what doesn't belong to me has entered. No foreign force has power over my life. May the light protect my home and purify everything around me. I break chains. I destroy bindings. I nullify every word of curse, every envy, every energy sent against me. What is not mine, I return to the void. My mind is free. My body is healthy. My spirit is strong. Where there was fear today, there is calm. Where there was crying today, there is peace. Where there was confusion today, clarity reigns. Nothing forged against me will prosper. Today every cycle of darkness closes, and a new time of light begins. My life and my home are protected. Silent intention is the most powerful. You don't need to shout or have anyone hear you. Your body and your soul receive the command. Do it every night before sleeping for seven nights. On the third day, something starts to move. The weight loosens, the mind clears, sleep improves, and things around you change. Write in the comments, Amen, if you receive this declaration and share it with whoever needs it. But declarations break and prayers protect. If fear, stress, and accumulated pain from years still live within you, your own weakened energy leaves you exposed to everything outside. The most powerful protection is not what you say. It is what you are inside. The day you build inner peace. Darkness has nowhere to enter, and if you want to build that peace from the root, I have been learning in silence for more than twenty years how to do it. And everything I know is inside the path back to calm. The link is in my profile.
